title: Cow waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='62' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#3b3b52'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='74' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3b3b52'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='80' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e7e2d4'/>
  <rect x='44' y='82' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e7e2d4'/>
  <rect x='56' y='82' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e7e2d4'/>
  <rect x='64' y='80' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e7e2d4'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='91' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='91' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='91' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <rect x='64' y='91' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <!-- raised waving arm -->
  <rect x='68' y='46' width='2' height='14' rx='2' fill='#c9b8a4'/>
  <path d='M 62 42 Q 60 34 66 32 Q 74 31 76 38 Q 77 45 70 47 Q 64 47 62 42 Z' fill='#e7e2d4'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='49' r='5' fill='#e7e2d4'/>
  <!-- head (rotated slightly) -->
  <g transform='rotate(-12 34 34)'>
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='34' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <ellipse cx='18' cy='24' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e7e2d4'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e7e2d4'/>
    <ellipse cx='18' cy='24' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#e8b4b8'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#e8b4b8'/>
    <!-- horns -->
    <path d='M 26 20 Q 24 14 27 12 Q 29 15 29 19 Z' fill='#f2d98f'/>
    <path d='M 42 20 Q 44 14 41 12 Q 39 15 39 19 Z' fill='#f2d98f'/>
    <!-- eye -->
    <circle cx='27' cy='32' r='3' fill='#3b3b52'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='31' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='40' cy='42' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#f5c9c4'/>
    <ellipse cx='36' cy='41' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#c98a94'/>
    <circle cx='39' cy='45' r='1.6' fill='#3b3b52'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='45' r='1.6' fill='#3b3b52'/>
    <!-- spots on head -->
    <ellipse cx='40' cy='26' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#3b3b52'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M 24 66 Q 16 64 14 58' stroke='#e7e2d4' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='56' r='3' fill='#3b3b52'/>
</svg>
